mentions.name: Monocle Search
mentions.description: Site-search engine aimed at people using Squarespace websites. It crawls and indexes pages, most common office documents and PDFs, runs OCR and feature extraction on images, and offers typeahead search as well as agentic/conversational AI search. It uses a bespoke search stack built around Tantivy (replacing Meilisearch), with search nodes distributed around the globe to provide the lowest possible latency regardless of where the end-user sits.
mentions.source_excerpt: We are working on our two site-search search engines Monocle Search [0] and SearchCue [1]. The former is squarely aimed at people using Squarespace, whereas our newer offering SearchCue is aimed at anyone with a site that wants to add search.
mentions.author: probst
